THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
032
STUDY 065
Silver Chains & Black Blazer
Rights check
Source: 24414.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with a high, sleek black
ponytail wears a black blazer over a sheer black lace
bralette. She has layered silver chain necklaces, a
small silver hoop earring, and bold red lips. Her gaze is
directed down and to the side. A deep blue studio
backdrop with soft directional light. Palette of cobalt,
black, and silver. Sharp and moody, in the style of a
cool-toned fashion editorial.
Sharp, moody, cool
WORKING NOTES
- The layered silver chains and blue backdrop create the
mood.
- Add 'dramatic side lighting' to sharpen the shadows.
Try this: Add dramatic side lighting.
